Trooper is a census-designated place (CDP) in Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, United States. The population was 5,744 at the 2010 census.


== Geography ==
Trooper is located at 40°8′56″N 75°23′50″W (40.148845, -75.397170).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 2.4 square miles (6.2 km2), all of it land.
